ChangeNotes.Value:
v3.1.0 - the voices install themselves now.
ONE BUTTON INSTEAD OF A SETUP PAGE * Talk screen, Voices, "Download the voices" - and the mod fetches the speech engine and its models itself. About 2.8 GB, in the background, while you carry on playing. * Nothing to install, no model list to hunt through, no administrator rights, and everything lands inside your own user folder. * A download that breaks off carries on from where it stopped rather than starting again. Stopping it yourself costs nothing either. * Already set voices up the old way? Then there is nothing to fetch and the button never appears.
SAID BEFORE YOU SPEND THE BANDWIDTH * Voices made on your own machine need an NVIDIA card - the speech engine has no other build. The mod now checks before it offers, instead of failing later. * On any other machine it points you at the hosted voices, which ask nothing of your hardware: just a key, billed by the minute. * The setup page said voices wanted about 7 GB. Measured: 2.9 GB. Corrected.
FIXES * The Voices page named the play mark with a symbol the game's fonts cannot draw, so the two lines telling you what to press showed empty boxes. It now shows the same note the buttons use. * The unread mark beside a name used a symbol from that same family.
Full record: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md Setting voices up: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/voiceover-setup.md
